text: A grey metal workbench holds a dark grey rack rail running from top-centre toward the bottom of the frame, mounted on a white aluminium extrusion beam. The rack has five circular holes; the four upper positions are empty. The nearest position holds an upright cylindrical specimen container with a bright orange screw cap, capped and closed. It carries a white label with red printing, and a red-tinted liquid is visible through the lower part of the body. At upper left is a white instrument with a green display panel showing orange digits, and a thick white plastic block sits on the bench at left. A black cable runs diagonally down the right side toward a black-and-white fitting; a blue device is at the top right corner.
